reason: A web interface plugin that calculates and displays DeepSeek session costs, daily usage, pricing details, and optional account balance information.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面中按 DeepSeek 价格计算并展示当前会话花费、今日用量和账户余额信息。
summaries.en: Displays calculated DeepSeek session costs, daily usage, and account balance information in the dsh web interface.

capabilities: Reads session logs to calculate per-message DeepSeek API costs
Displays current-session and daily DeepSeek usage totals
Reads the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential to request account balance from the DeepSeek balance API
Adds a cost badge and hover details panel to the web interface
